text: Follow-up to feature covering stash A9D74372 (Stage harvest docline hardening): (a) Direction 3 DEFERRED from that chore — change how the Stage harvest commit reaches the Ship feature branch so a Stage-artifact defect (beyond docline frontmatter, e.g. committed-file scope) cannot ride into a Ship PR. Options: Stage pushes its harvest commit to origin/main before Ship branches, or harvest lands via a dedicated delivery mechanism. Larger blast radius (branch/push topology, partly Ship-owned) — evaluate before implementing. (b) Upstream template drift: the docline frontmatter contract + pre-harvest lint gate were applied to the in-repo .github/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md and harvest/SKILL.md, but the generating .tmpl sources live in the external autoharness repo; update them there (never via out-of-tree writes from this workspace, per Principle IV) so a regeneration does not overwrite the fix. Provision npm publishing credentials for @backlogit (EXTERNAL, human-only follow-up carved out of 080-S / stash 9140F65C in-repo slice): (1) provision the @backlogit org/scope on npmjs.org; (2) create an npm automation token with publish rights and add it as repo secret NPM_TOKEN. No agent (Stage or Ship) can perform these -- they require npm-org and repo-secret provisioning. Once done, the NPM_TOKEN presence guard shipped in task 080.001-T lets the release.yml npm-publish job's publish steps run automatically on the next release (no workflow change needed).

DIAGNOSIS 2026-07-04: Root cause of the v1.3.0 npm-publish failure (run 28488788268, job 84441217752) confirmed = npm error code E404 "PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@backlogit%2flinux-x64 - Not found / is not in this registry". The existing NPM_TOKEN authenticated successfully (npm built the tarball; no ENEEDAUTH/EOTP) -- 404-on-PUT is npm's signal that the authenticated account does NOT own the @backlogit scope. So the token is valid; the missing piece is that the @backlogit organization/scope is not provisioned under the token's npm account. Fix = create npm org named "backlogit" (claims @backlogit scope) owned by / with the NPM_TOKEN user as a publisher; then validate with a prerelease tag (e.g. v1.3.1-rc.1) which triggers release.yml and actually attempts publish (--access public already set; platform packages publish before the wrapper). No repo/workflow change required unless the "backlogit" org name is unavailable (then rename all 6 npm/*/package.json + release.yml publish loop to a new scope).
